name: M3_PDS010MI_LstRelPerWC
description: List resource relationships for work centers within a facility. The operation returns, for each work center and work center resource pair, the planning attributes that guide advanced planning and scheduling: description, scheduling priority, efficiency factor, forced and preferred resource indicators, norm resource, line control, and full audit information. Use it to review or export how resources are connected to work centers and how they will be considered by automatic scheduling in an APP/Scheduling Workbench environment. The data is read-only and reflects the current configuration.

inputParameters.name: FACI
inputParameters.description: Facility for which work center–resource relations are listed.

inputParameters.name: PLG1
inputParameters.description: APP work center used as a filter when listing resource relations within the facility.

outputParameters.name: FACI
outputParameters.description: Facility to which this work center–resource relationship belongs.

outputParameters.name: PLG1
outputParameters.description: APP work center that this resource relationship belongs to.

outputParameters.name: PLG6
outputParameters.description: Work center resource linked to the APP work center in this relationship.

outputParameters.name: DSCR
outputParameters.description: Text description of the work center–resource relationship.

outputParameters.name: PRIR
outputParameters.description: Priority value used by automatic scheduling when choosing between this resource and alternative resources.

outputParameters.name: PLGF
outputParameters.description: Indicates that this resource must be used for operations when this relationship applies.

outputParameters.name: PLGN
outputParameters.description: Reference norm resource used for reporting and analyzing utilization in this relationship.

outputParameters.name: EFFA
outputParameters.description: Efficiency factor for this relationship used to adjust run time when calculating load and lead time.

outputParameters.name: RPLF
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether line control restricts subsequent operations to resources on the same line as this resource.

outputParameters.name: SECR
outputParameters.description: Marks the resource as preferred so it is selected first by the automatic scheduler for this relationship.

outputParameters.name: RGDT
outputParameters.description: Date when this work center–resource relationship record was created.

outputParameters.name: RGTM
outputParameters.description: Time when this work center–resource relationship record was created.

outputParameters.name: LMDT
outputParameters.description: Date when this work center–resource relationship record was last changed.

outputParameters.name: CHNO
outputParameters.description: Change number identifying the current version of this work center–resource relationship record.

outputParameters.name: CHID
outputParameters.description: User who last changed this work center–resource relationship record.

outputParameters.name: LMTS
outputParameters.description: System timestamp for the last update of this work center–resource relationship record.
